findings.title: New table visualization discards the widget's query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, the chart passes empty columns, empty data, and empty metadata to TableWidgetVisualization instead of the actual `result`. Every dashboard table widget in an enabled organization therefore renders empty even when its query returned rows. Pass the real results and configured columns into the new visualization before enabling this branch.

findings.title: Attribute query cache is not scoped to the organization
findings.body: The new query key contains only the query options, while the query function fetches an organization-specific endpoint. Two organizations with the same project selection (for example, all projects), date range, item type, and attribute type share a cache entry. Switching organizations can therefore display custom attribute names fetched from the previous organization, and concurrent consumers can reuse the wrong organization's results. Include the organization slug or endpoint path in the query key.

findings.title: Normalize error and recording timestamps before merging
findings.body: Error timestamps read from nodestore are Unix seconds, but recording events use rrweb timestamps in Unix milliseconds. Comparing these values directly causes essentially every error to be emitted before the first recording event, regardless of when it actually occurred. The new tests use seconds for recording timestamps and consequently miss this production behavior. Convert recording timestamps to seconds, or error timestamps to milliseconds, before performing the chronological merge.

findings.title: Respect falsy results from custom cell renderers
findings.body: Both custom renderer wrappers use `if (cell)` to decide whether to accept the custom result, although the documented contract says only `undefined` invokes the fallback. Valid React results such as `0`, an empty string, or `null` are therefore replaced by the default renderer. This prevents callers from intentionally rendering zero or suppressing a cell's contents. Check explicitly for `undefined` in both the header and body wrappers.
